app_info.subtitle: Plan, run, and verify work
app_info.description: ToolYour helps users plan technical work, run specialized playbooks and tools, verify results, and reuse project knowledge through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds a ranked execution plan and reads relevant feature memory without changing stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Plans only against ToolYour's bounded catalog and the user's private project context.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, publish, or authorize irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves matching feature-memory context without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only the user's bounded ToolYour feature-memory store.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove stored feature memory.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a feature-memory record in the user's ToolYour account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's bounded private ToolYour workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new record without deleting or irreversibly replacing existing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists stored feature-memory records without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the user's bounded ToolYour feature-memory store.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or publish feature-memory records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Publishes a selected private feature pattern to the ToolYour community catalog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes content available to an open-ended community audience outside the user's private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a community publication without deleting the original private feature record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads two stored feature records and computes a comparison without changing either record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Compares records only within the bounded ToolYour feature-memory system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, publish, or revoke any record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves community feature patterns without modifying community or private data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from ToolYour's bounded community catalog rather than arbitrary external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not publish, unpublish, delete, or replace community content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a selected feature-memory record from the user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only within the user's bounded private ToolYour workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected stored feature record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the publication state of a community feature pattern.
justifications.open_world_justification: Removes content previously exposed to an open-ended community audience.
justifications.destructive_justification: Withdraws the selected pattern from the public community catalog.

justifications.read_only_justification: May execute catalog tools and persist run or feature-memory state while solving the task.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can invoke catalog operations that interact with open-ended external services and content.
justifications.destructive_justification: The orchestrator does not itself expose deletion or irreversible transaction controls.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a multi-step playbook and records execution state and results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Playbook steps can invoke tools that access open-ended external services and content.
justifications.destructive_justification: The playbook runner does not expose a direct delete or irreversible transaction operation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs verification operations and may record verification and feature-memory results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Verification may call tools that inspect open-ended external services or content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Verification does not directly delete data or execute irreversible transactions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches ToolYour's tool registry and returns matching metadata without executing tools.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to ToolYour's bounded catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not run, modify, or remove any catalog tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists categories from the ToolYour registry without changing registry data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only ToolYour's bounded catalog taxonomy.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not add, update, or remove categories.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a catalog tool's schema and metadata without invoking it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from ToolYour's bounded registry.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute tools or change registry entries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes a selected catalog tool, which can create run state or cause external side effects.
justifications.open_world_justification: Catalog tools can operate on open-ended external services, URLs, and content.
justifications.destructive_justification: The generic invocation surface excludes direct destructive execution tools and does not itself delete records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists installed ToolYour skill metadata without running or modifying skills.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only ToolYour's bounded skill catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not install, update, execute, or remove skills.

justifications.read_only_justification: Loads instructions for one registered skill without executing or modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from ToolYour's bounded skill catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update, delete, or execute skill content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a stored ToolYour payload by reference without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from ToolYour's bounded payload store.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, or publish stored payloads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves status and results for an existing ToolYour run without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only run data within the user's bounded ToolYour account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not cancel, restart, or remove the run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes multiple workflow steps and records run state and outputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Workflow steps can interact with open-ended external services and content.
justifications.destructive_justification: The workflow runner does not expose a direct delete or irreversible transaction operation.

test_cases.description: Plan a production-readiness workflow before any execution begins.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a ranked plan to check whether my web application is ready for production, but do not run anything yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a ranked plan, relevant project context, and a clear indication of whether execution should begin.

test_cases.description: Run a supported SEO audit playbook for a public site.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run the SEO audit playbook for https://www.toolyour.com and summarize the highest-priority findings.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs the selected playbook and returns prioritized findings with structured execution results.

test_cases.description: Verify the result of a prior technical task.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify that the completed production-readiness task passed its required checks and explain any failures.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns verification status, evidence for each check, and concise remediation guidance for failures.

test_cases.description: Discover a suitable utility without executing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find ToolYour tools that can convert a PDF into images; show me the best matches without running them.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching catalog tools with enough metadata to select the appropriate converter.

test_cases.description: Execute a specifically requested catalog utility.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use the appropriate ToolYour catalog tool to convert my supplied document to PDF.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes the selected converter and returns a clear result or a precise request for any required missing input.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for personal calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my design team tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or meetings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for email composition or sending.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write and send an email to my customer about their invoice.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide email delivery workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for financial trading or payments.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy 20 shares of a technology stock for me right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot place trades or perform financial transactions.
